name: octaweave_list_notes
description: List notes in the workspace, newest-updated first. Returns {items, next_cursor}; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` for the next page (null means last page). Each item has id, title, slug, version, updated_at, is_favorite, labels — not the body. Use octaweave_get_note for content, or octaweave_search when you know roughly what you are looking for.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

label.description: Optional label name to filter by.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.
